name: Buffer Cache 调优 — 命中率诊断与调优
description: Buffer Cache 是 SGA 中缓存数据块的区域。命中率低意味着大量物理 I/O，直接影响查询性能。本规则覆盖 Buffer Cache 命中率诊断、db_cache_size 调优、Buffer Pool (KEEP/RECYCLE/DEFAULT) 使用策略。

skip_when.desc: 命中率 > 99% 且无 free buffer waits

root_causes.name: db_cache_size 过小
root_causes.desc: Buffer Cache 大小不足以缓存活跃数据集。大量块被频繁换出，物理读增多。

root_causes.name: SQL 导致大量全表扫描
root_causes.desc: 低效 SQL 执行全表扫描，大量数据块涌入 Buffer Cache 冲刷掉热点块。

root_causes.name: 未使用 KEEP Pool 保护热点小表
root_causes.desc: 频繁访问的小表未放入 KEEP Pool，可能被全表扫描冲刷。

root_causes.name: ASMM/AMM 导致 Buffer Cache 被缩小
root_causes.desc: 自动内存管理将 Buffer Cache 内存分给其他组件。

step1_hit_ratio.desc: 计算 Buffer Cache 命中率
step1_hit_ratio.sql: SELECT ROUND((1 - (phys.value / (db.value + cons.value))) * 100, 2) hit_ratio FROM v$sysstat phys, v$sysstat db, v$sysstat cons WHERE phys.name = 'physical reads' AND db.name = 'db block gets' AND cons.name = 'consistent gets'

step2_cache_size.desc: 检查 Buffer Cache 大小
step2_cache_size.sql: SELECT component, current_size/1024/1024 current_mb, min_size/1024/1024 min_mb, max_size/1024/1024 max_mb FROM v$sga_dynamic_components WHERE component LIKE '%buffer%' OR component LIKE '%cache%'

step3_cache_advisory.sql: SELECT size_for_estimate mb, buffers_for_estimate, estd_physical_read_factor, estd_physical_reads FROM v$db_cache_advice WHERE name = 'DEFAULT' AND block_size = (SELECT value FROM v$parameter WHERE name = 'db_block_size') ORDER BY size_for_estimate

step4_free_buffer_waits.sql: SELECT event, total_waits, ROUND(time_waited_micro/1e6) total_sec FROM v$system_event WHERE event = 'free buffer waits'

step5_full_scan_sql.sql: SELECT sql_id, disk_reads, buffer_gets, executions, ROUND(disk_reads/GREATEST(executions,1)) reads_per_exec FROM v$sqlarea WHERE disk_reads > 10000 ORDER BY disk_reads DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY
